packageRules.description: typescript-5 gives openapi-typescript 7 the TypeScript 5 compiler API that TypeScript 7 no longer ships (scripts/nixie-api/generate-nixie-api-types.ts), so it stays on 5

A provider/go.mod bump changes the vendored Go modules, whose vendorHash in nixos/packages/onidel-provider.nix Renovate cannot recompute, so CI's onidel vendor hash check fails it until a reviewer commits the new hash. automerge false says so, and groupName null keeps it out of the weekly patch group, whose other bumps would otherwise wait on its failed check

customManagers.description: The provider declares the generated SDK's @types/node in provider/internal/onidel/provider.go, and scripts/check-sdk.sh fails a bump of sdk/onidel/package.json that the provider does not match, so this manager bumps both in one PR
